mapper.insert: insert into gym.member_course (course_id, course_name, user_id, user_name, status, order_num) value (#{courseId},#{courseName},#{userId},#{userRealName},#{status},#{orderNum})
mapper.update: update gym.member_course set status = #{status} where id = #{courseId}
update gym.member_course set status = #{status} , refuse_reason = #{refuseReason} where id = #{memberCourseId}
mapper.select: select * from gym.member_course mc where mc.user_id = #{userId} and mc.status = 1 and exists ( select 1 from gym.course c where c.id = mc.course_id and c.course_type = 1 )

select mc.*, u.real_name,c2.duration,c2.coach_id from gym.member_course mc left join gym.course c2 on mc.course_id = c2.id left join gym.user u on c2.coach_id = u.id where mc.user_id = #{userId} and (mc.status = 1 or mc.status = 2) and exists ( select 1 from gym.course c where c.id = mc.course_id and c.course_type = 2 )
